verdict.rationale: Structured interview scorecards are a fair question for an applicant tracking system like Recruitee, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions scorecards, evaluation attributes, rubrics, or interviewer scoring. The closest items are generic templates and event scheduling, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews are scored on structured scorecards — defined attributes per stage, focused rubrics per interviewer, comparable across candidates
